careerDirection.directionDescription: Product management and UX design sit at the intersection of technology and user experience. Associate product managers and product analysts define product features and measure performance. UX designers and UI designers design the interfaces that users interact with. BCA graduates who understand technology architecture and user-centred design principles are well placed for these roles at technology companies and digital product teams.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Software development is the primary and most direct career outcome for BCA graduates. The curriculum covers programming languages (C, Java, Python, PHP), data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles. Frontend, backend, and full-stack developer roles at IT services companies, product startups, and technology firms are the most consistent entry-level destinations for BCA graduates with practical coding competency.

careerDirection.directionDescription: IT support and systems administration roles involve managing hardware, software, networks, and user support within organisations. BCA graduates with networking and operating system knowledge enter technical support, help desk, and systems administration roles. These positions are available across every industry sector and provide a stable career entry point for BCA graduates who prefer infrastructure over application development.
